title: DoctorRecord
description: Standard schema for importing verified real doctor records into MediSphere

name.description: Full legal or professional name of the doctor (e.g. 'Dr. Sunita Sharma')

speciality.description: Medical specialty. Must match one of: Dermatology, ENT, Dentistry, Cardiology, Neurology, Orthopedics

qualification.description: Official medical qualifications and degrees (e.g. 'MBBS, MD (Dermatology)'). Use null if unconfirmed.

experience_years.description: Verified years of clinical experience. Use null if unconfirmed.

consultation_fee.description: Published consultation fee in INR (₹). Use null if unconfirmed.

about.description: Brief verified professional summary or clinical focus. Use null if unavailable.

clinic.description: Name of affiliated hospital or clinic. Use null if practice address is independent or unconfirmed.

address.description: Physical practice street address. Use null if unconfirmed.

city.description: City of practice (e.g. 'Bhopal'). Use null if unconfirmed.

state.description: State of practice (e.g. 'Madhya Pradesh'). Use null if unconfirmed.

phone.description: Official public clinic contact number. Use null if unconfirmed.

website.description: Official practice or clinic website URL. Use null if unavailable.

source.description: Verifiable public source of the information (e.g., State Medical Council Registry, Official Hospital Directory). REQUIRED for all imports.

verification_status.description: Verification state. Always defaults to 'pending' upon import. Never automatically verified.
